failures.evidence: Red test TestAClosedDocumentsIdenticalParagraphsKeepTheirOwnHistory, commit 44cf9cac in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/block_index_test.go. Command: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://… go test -count=1 -run TestAClosedDocumentsIdenticalParagraphsKeepTheirOwnHistory ./internal/dispatch/docs/. Head: FAIL 'block f3387491-… that version 1 holds is dated 0 (text at version 1 false, deleted at version 1 true)'. cb3a2711: FAIL on the other half ('the inserted paragraph … which no version holds, has a text at version 1'). Real surface (edge_h4, head): version 1 '## Plan / Same. / Same. / Other. / Same. / Alpha. / Beta. / Gamma.' was indexed while ED-1 was open (third Same. = 538a70a2, v1). With versions refused, alice typed a new 'Same.' after 'Other.' (49a2b5b9) and moved Alpha by cut and paste (a new id). SetStatus closed ED-1 and rebuild-refs ran. Closed: 538a70a2 answers 'No block', with a deletion row at version 1; 49a2b5b9 answers 'Changed in version: 1'. After the reopen and version 2: 538a70a2 is 'Changed in version: 2' and its @v1 pin answers 'no block … at version 1'; 49a2b5b9 stays 'Changed in version: 1' with a text at version 1. The cause: closedVersionBlocks aligns untyped blocks by text alone with difflib, whose longest match pairs version 1's third 'Same.' with the new paragraph, although the index holds 538a70a2's own row with that text. Edge the design leaves open: in the deploy order with no earlier index, a block that version 1 holds and that an unsettled edit changed in place has no row and no live match, so it answers 'No block' while the issue is closed.
